desc: Parse N, M and the constraints.
For each bit k from 0 to 30:
Initialize DSU with parity for N elements.
If bit k of z is 1, union x and y with parity 1; else union with parity 0.
If union detects inconsistency (x and y already connected but required parity differs), mark impossible.
After processing all bits, if any bit impossible, print -1.

Otherwise, for each bit k, for each DSU component, decide root bit = 0 or 1 by counting how many nodes would have bit 1 under each choice (based on parity to root). Choose the smaller count, set root bit accordingly, and assign bits to all nodes in component.
Combine per-bit bits into integer A_i.
Print A_1 … A_N separated by spaces.
